label: Figure 21.2: A deflationary gap/output gap
alt: Panel (a): AD/AS diagram with AD1 crossing SRAS to the left of the vertical LRAS line, at output Y1 below full-employment output Yf, showing a deflationary gap. Panel (b): a bowed-out PPC with point a plotted inside the curve.
caption: Panel (a): aggregate demand AD<sub>1</sub> intersects SRAS at output Y<sub>1</sub>, which lies to the left of potential output Y<sub>f</sub> marked by the vertical LRAS line – the horizontal distance is the deflationary (output) gap. Panel (b): the same idea on a production possibilities curve, where point a sits inside PPC<sub>1</sub>, showing resources not fully employed.
